hypothesis: The two-stage message interface can recover grounded evidence when it exists and return no claim when the supplied packet contains only similar noise.

answerable.input: Each original question packet, containing two required sources plus its frozen distractors.
answerable.pass: Both required source messages produce mechanically exact evidence.

no_answer_in_packet.input: The question remains unchanged, but both required sources are removed before inference and only similar distractors remain.

pipeline: Replace real source identifiers with M1, M2 and so on.
Qwen3-8B selects zero to three message handles.
Qwen3-8B reads each selected message separately and writes short claims plus source-line handles.
Ordinary code validates every handle, blocks placeholder text, and reconstructs exact source lines.
The frozen source map scores required evidence and false-positive sources.
primary_metrics: answerable cases with both required sources
no-answer cases with zero accepted claims
claim_boundary: This gate tests only selection and grounded extraction inside a supplied candidate packet. It does not test library-wide retrieval, DeBERTa, final writing, privacy filtering or a physical swarm.
privacy: All test text is from the public synthetic E007 world; no owner memory is used.
